about: Cluster naming (ai/cluster_labeler.py). Real clusters of the demo maps after the 21 Oct 2026 rebuild, every member as [name, type, degree]; run.py picks what the labeller sees with graph.clustering.label_sample, as the build does. No gold labels: run.py checks properties every label must have. forbid: words injected into member names that must not reach the label.
